subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should embedded-runner startup phases become a supported public plugin diagnostic event contract through `DiagnosticEventPayload` and `onDiagnosticEvent`?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it permanently expands a shipped plugin API union and exposes an agent-owned closed phase vocabulary to external consumers; code review cannot choose that contract boundary.

options.title: Approve the public event
options.body: Treat `run.execution_phase` as an additive public diagnostic event, retain the compatibility guidance and tests, and merge after real runtime proof is posted.

options.title: Keep phases internal
options.body: Record phases only through internal diagnostics and stability surfaces, avoiding a new plugin SDK union member until a broader versioned event-contract design exists.

recommendation.title: Approve the public event
recommendation.body: Treat `run.execution_phase` as an additive public diagnostic event, retain the compatibility guidance and tests, and merge after real runtime proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the diagnostic bus, plugin diagnostic hooks, public/trusted event boundaries, and OTel lifecycle event design.
